scope: Android Flutter voice smoke with a 30-second Home + screen-off interval, lifecycle-aware test resume, and normal leave/logout cleanup. No independent receiver or audible media acceptance.

environment.microphone_permission: Granted by the isolated QA runner

scenario.background_action: KEYCODE_HOME followed by AVD screen off
scenario.resume_action: AVD screen wake followed by MainActivity start
scenario.lifecycle_wait: The integration helper waits for AppLifecycleState.resumed before interacting with widgets; timeout is 75 minutes.
scenario.unit_tests: 2 passed: waits for resumed state; bounded timeout when no resume occurs
scenario.normal_leave_logout_cleanup: PASS_SCOPED; subsequent dumpsys listed no MicrophoneService, the emulator was awake, and the app process had exited after the test completed.

visual_review.observation: At source resolution, the screenshot shows RNNoise active and the connected voice dock with one participant. No visible defect in the captured audio settings or dock.

limitations: This is a short emulator check, not the 60-minute device acceptance.
The QA runtime report marks media NOT_RUN; no independent receiver RTP/decoded-audio counters or audible output were measured.
The emulator microphone input level was zero; the screenshot and service state do not establish intelligible voice transmission.
The keyguard lock state was not verified; screen asleep alone does not prove keyguard lock.
No physical Android/iOS matrix, network switching, battery saver, permission revoke, incoming call, release manifest, or production smoke was run.
The earlier 60-minute FGS observation is recorded separately and its Flutter runner failed in pumpAndSettle before leave/logout; this short pass does not replace a rerun of the 60-minute scenario.
Issue #785 remains open; this scoped result does not close its release gate.
